scope: Compiler-host transport only. No kernel implementation, acceptance or private ABI changes.
entry: --session-products-v2[-modules]-lean|ps. Protocol version must agree in prepared, checked and emitted responses; no downgrade or private fallback.
representationField: Retained closed value from the version-1 tuple; it does not select a JS backend or the private Wasm ABI. Only explicit Canonical Wasm is admitted by version 2.
response: Exactly two bounded frames, including checked-only mode. Emission includes exact interfaceJson/bindingJson in addition to Wasm bytes and mandatory RuntimeIR/VerifiedIR/SpecializedIR/WasmIR; metadata also includes PublicApiIR, erasure and origin tables.
invariants: One actual prepared source lives across parent acceptance and one selected staged emission.
Exact admissions are rechecked before and after target emission.
The host snapshots and pins export selection bytes before starting the process.
Both native and generated hosts use the same independent projection and target/binary signature checks.
Unknown fields, version mismatch, failed checks, extra frames, timeout or unsuccessful process exit cannot return a product.
Builder graph products must equal the captured selected policy/interface/binding bytes before publication.
compatibility: psc-checked-seed-products/1 remains exact for direct JS/private wasm32. Legacy TS transport remains unchanged.
limitations: Native getLine allocation and total compiler CPU/memory remain unproved.
The current runtime supports closed scalar synchronous Canonical exports only.
Signature agreement and source acceptance do not prove source-to-target preservation.
Imported callbacks, aggregate conversion, resource/async lifetimes and complete component runtime remain pending.
